caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, showing both the front and left side. The chair has a tall back with four horizontal slats, each irregularly shaped and colored in shades of light brown with visible wood grain texture. The side posts of the backrest are cylindrical with rounded tops. The seat is made of woven material in a crisscross pattern, depicted in muted tan and brown tones that also show texture detail. The chair legs are rounded and connected by horizontal stretchers for stability; these legs and stretchers are rendered in similar brown shades as the rest of the chair. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are no other objects present. The signature "Annie B. Johnston" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Ladder Back Chair
